1: // Canvas Runner Game
2: // Implements the idea from IDEA.md: a side‑scrolling endless runner.
3: // The HTML contains <canvas id="game"></canvas>. This script initializes the canvas
4: // and starts the game loop.
5: 
6: (() => {
7:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
8:   if (!canvas) {
9:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
10:     return;
11:   }
12:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
13: 
14:   // Audio context for sound effects
15:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
16:   const playTone = (freq, duration) => {
17:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
18:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
19:     osc.type = 'sine';
20:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
21:     osc.connect(gain);
22:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
23:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
24:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
25:     osc.start();
26:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
27:   };
28: 
29:   // Set canvas size (you can adjust as needed)
30:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = 800;
31:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = 200;
32: 
33:   // Game constants
34:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
35:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
36:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 30;
37:   const SCROLL_SPEED = 4;
38:   const OBSTACLE_WIDTH = 20;
39:   const GAP_WIDTH = 80;
40:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
41: 
42:   // Player state
43:   const player = {
44:     x: 50,
45:     y: HEIGHT - PLAYER_SIZE,
46:     vy: 0,
47:     onGround: true,
48:   };
49: 
50:   // Ground representation: an array of segments. Each segment is {x, width, solid}
51:   // "solid" true means ground exists, false means a gap.
52:   let groundSegments = [{ x: 0, width: WIDTH, solid: true }];
53: 
54:   // Obstacles array: each {x, y, width, height}
55:   let obstacles = [];
56: 
57:   // Timing
58:   let lastSpawn = 0;
59:   let lastTime = performance.now();
60:   let gameOver = false;
61: 
62:   // Input handling
63:   const jump = () => {
64:     // Ensure audio context is running (required after user gesture)
65:     if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume();
66:     if (player.onGround) {
67:       player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
68:       player.onGround = false;
69:       // Play jump sound (high‑pitched short tone)
70:       playTone(600, 0.1);
71:     }
72:   };
73:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
74:     if (e.code === 'Space') jump();
75:   });
76:   canvas.addEventListener('click', jump);
77: 
78:   // Helper to add a new ground segment (solid or gap) at the right edge
79:   function addGroundSegment() {
80:     const last = groundSegments[groundSegments.length - 1];
81:     const solid = Math.random() > 0.3; // 70% chance solid, 30% gap
82:     const width = solid ? OBSTACLE_WIDTH * 2 + Math.random() * 100 : GAP_WIDTH;
83:     groundSegments.push({ x: last.x + last.width, width, solid });
84:   }
85: 
86:   // Helper to spawn an obstacle on a solid ground segment
87:   function maybeSpawnObstacle() {
88:     // Find the first solid segment that is currently on screen
89:     const segment = groundSegments.find(seg => seg.solid && seg.x + seg.width > player.x);
90:     if (!segment) return;
91:     // Random chance to add obstacle
92:     if (Math.random() < 0.4) {
93:       const obsHeight = PLAYER_SIZE * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.6);
94:       obstacles.push({
95:         x: segment.x + segment.width - OBSTACLE_WIDTH,
96:         y: HEIGHT - PLAYER_SIZE - obsHeight,
97:         width: OBSTACLE_WIDTH,
98:         height: obsHeight,
99:       });
100:     }
101:   }
102: 
103:   function update(delta) {
104:     if (gameOver) return;
105:     // Update player physics
106:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
107:     player.y += player.vy;
108: 
109:     // Determine ground height at player.x
110:     const groundY = HEIGHT - PLAYER_SIZE;
111:     // Find current ground segment under player
112:     const currentSeg = groundSegments.find(seg => player.x >= seg.x && player.x < seg.x + seg.width);
113:     const onSolid = currentSeg && currentSeg.solid;
114:     if (onSolid && player.y >= groundY) {
115:       player.y = groundY;
116:       player.vy = 0;
117:       player.onGround = true;
118:     } else if (!onSolid && player.y >= HEIGHT) {
119:       // Fell into a gap
120:       player.y = HEIGHT;
121:       player.vy = 0;
122:       player.onGround = false;
123:     }
124: 
125:     // Scroll world left
126:     groundSegments.forEach(seg => seg.x -= SCROLL_SPEED);
127:     obstacles.forEach(ob => ob.x -= SCROLL_SPEED);
128: 
129:     // Remove off‑screen parts
130:     while (groundSegments.length && groundSegments[0].x + groundSegments[0].width < 0) {
131:       groundSegments.shift();
132:     }
133:     while (obstacles.length && obstacles[0].x + obstacles[0].width < 0) {
134:       obstacles.shift();
135:     }
136: 
137:     // Extend ground if needed
138:     const rightEdge = groundSegments[groundSegments.length - 1].x + groundSegments[groundSegments.length - 1].width;
139:     if (rightEdge < WIDTH * 2) addGroundSegment();
140: 
141:     // Possibly spawn obstacle
142:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
143:       maybeSpawnObstacle();
144:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
145:     }
146: 
147:     // Collision detection with obstacles
148:     for (const ob of obstacles) {
149:       if (
150:         player.x < ob.x + ob.width &&
151:         player.x + PLAYER_SIZE > ob.x &&
152:         player.y < ob.y + ob.height &&
153:         player.y + PLAYER_SIZE > ob.y
154:       ) {
155:           // Play collision sound (low-pitched short tone)
156:           playTone(200, 0.3);
157:           gameOver = true;
158:           break;
159:         }
160:       }
161:     }
162:   }
163: 
164:     }
165:   }
166: 
167:   function draw() {
168:     // Background gradient
169:     const bgGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, HEIGHT);
170:     bgGradient.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB'); // sky blue
171:     bgGradient.addColorStop(1, '#b3e5fc'); // lighter at horizon
172:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGradient;
173:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
174: 
175:     // Draw ground with simple texture pattern
176:     const groundPatternCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
177:     groundPatternCanvas.width = 20;
178:     groundPatternCanvas.height = 20;
179:     const gpCtx = groundPatternCanvas.getContext('2d');
180:     gpCtx.fillStyle = '#654321';
181:     gpCtx.fillRect(0, 0, 20, 20);
182:     gpCtx.fillStyle = '#7b543c';
183:     gpCtx.fillRect(0, 10, 20, 10);
184:     const groundPattern = ctx.createPattern(groundPatternCanvas, 'repeat');
185:     ctx.fillStyle = groundPattern;
186:     for (const seg of groundSegments) {
187:       if (seg.solid) {
188:         ctx.fillRect(seg.x, HEIGHT - PLAYER_SIZE, seg.width, PLAYER_SIZE);
189:       }
190:     }
191: 
192:     // Draw player as rounded square
193:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5722';
194:     const radius = 6;
195:     ctx.beginPath();
196:     ctx.moveTo(player.x + radius, player.y);
197:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + PLAYER_SIZE - radius, player.y);
198:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + PLAYER_SIZE, player.y, player.x + PLAYER_SIZE, player.y + radius);
199:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + PLAYER_SIZE, player.y + PLAYER_SIZE - radius);
200:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + PLAYER_SIZE, player.y + PLAYER_SIZE, player.x + PLAYER_SIZE - radius, player.y + PLAYER_SIZE);
201:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + radius, player.y + PLAYER_SIZE);
202:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y + PLAYER_SIZE, player.x, player.y + PLAYER_SIZE - radius);
203:     ctx.lineTo(player.x, player.y + radius);
204:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y, player.x + radius, player.y);
205:     ctx.closePath();
206:     ctx.fill();
207: 
208:     // Draw obstacles with a darker shade
209:     ctx.fillStyle = '#424242';
210:     for (const ob of obstacles) {
211:       ctx.fillRect(ob.x, ob.y, ob.width, ob.height);
212:     }
213:     // Game over overlay
214:     if (gameOver) {
215:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
216:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
217:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
218:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
219:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
220:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2);
221:     }
222:   }
223: 
224:   function loop(timestamp) {
225:     const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
226:     lastTime = timestamp;
227:     update(delta);
228:     draw();
229:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
230:   }
231: 
232:   // Initialise first ground segment if empty (should already be)
233:   if (!groundSegments.length) addGroundSegment();
234: 
235:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
236: })();
